lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Commander!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I'm utterly dumbfounded right now.
What happened?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Okay, I want an answer from you,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: and it better be the right answer.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What do you think about my body?
What?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Get your mind out of the gutter!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Do you think I have a nice figure?
It's well-balanced, so yes.
You've got some attractive musculature, and nice, soft skin.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: That's what I think too.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: That was very... specific.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: *Sigh*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I went to buy some clothes,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: but nothing fit me.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I asked the employee if they had anything else, and you know what she said?
That's you're a bit... stout?
That the clothes were all a size small?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yes! That's exactly what she said!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: She's saying I can't squeeze into any of these clothes because I'm too fat.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: If she'd used a bit of tact and said it indirectly like that, I wouldn't have been upset.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Instead, she basically said straight to my face that I was a land whale.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Am I really that fat?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Should I go on a diet?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: How does a Nikke even go on a diet?
You're just more on the voluptuous side. There's nothing wrong with that.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Thank you,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: but I'd rather not be hearing these kinds of remarks at a clothing store.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Argh!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Anyway, thanks for letting me vent.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I've gotta give this some more thought.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Bye.
Bye.
